title: Preventive Maintenance Agreements — Discount Earned by the Building's Automation Plan on Reinstatement
content:
## Portfolio ruling

A discount is earned against the reinstatement charge of a Preventive Maintenance Agreements record by the building automation service plan at the agreement's building, held under the Building Automation Service Plans. Two readings decide it: whether that plan stands in active status, and whether its support pool still carries hours.

| The building automation service plan at the agreement's building | Discount earned |
|---|---|
| stands in active status and still carries support hours in its pool | the plan discount, 120.00 USD |
| stands in active status and its support pool is exhausted | the part plan discount, 50.00 USD |
| the owner holds no building automation service plan in active status | no discount |

### Notes

- A support pool standing above nothing still carries hours and earns 120.00 USD; a pool standing at nothing or less is exhausted and earns 50.00 USD.
- The plan read is the one at the agreement's own building, with its status and remaining support hours taken from the owner's Building Automation Service Plans records.
- The discount is one figure, subtracted once from the sum.

### Illustration (hypothetical)

A reinstatement charge standing at 420.00 USD before the discount becomes 300.00 USD where the building's automation plan is active with support hours left, and 370.00 USD where that plan is active with its pool exhausted.
